 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Md. Javed Jafar Khan, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Khurshid Anwar, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Chandra Shekhar Jha

ORAL ORDER 2 03-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2.

The accused/petitioner is named in the FIR and apprehending his arrest in connection with Raushanganj P.S. Case No.102 of 2017 registered under Sections 376, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. As per FIR, the allegation of rape was raised against the petitioner when petitioner and his family refused to solemnize marriage with informant due to non-fulfilment of dowry demand as raised for cash of Rs.3 lakhs.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.75412 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 4
. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for petitioner that the informant herself stated through FIR that she established physical relationship with this petitioner.
It is submitted that from the narration as available through FIR, it cannot be said safely that physical relation was not established against the will of informant.
It is pointed out that at the time of marriage when the demand of dowry for cash of Rs.3 lakhs was raised, the present false allegation of rape was raised against petitioner.

It is pointed out that the corporeal relation relationship on pretext of marriage Md. Jibrail Ansari vs The State Of Bihar on 3 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34643729/
1 cannot be termed as rape.

entities.text: Pramod Suryabhan Pawar vs. State of Maharshtra and Anr. [(2019) 9 SCC 608]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP opposed the prayer of bail.

6. In view of aforesaid factual submissions and by taking note of fact as prima facie the allegation of rape appears to be made in the background of false pretext of marriage, when demand of dowry was raised for cash of Rs.3 Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.75412 of 2025(2) dt.03-11-2025 lakhs by the petitioner and his family members, accordingly, the petitioner, above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks from today, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M., Sherghati, Gaya in connection with Raushanganj P.S. Case No.102 of 2017, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2)
of the Code of Criminal Procedure (in short 'CrPC')/under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short 'BNSS').
(Chandra Shekhar Jha, J.) Sanjeet/-
